commands.outputSemantics: Use replay --dry-run before executing. Real replay stops at the first failed step and returns failure workflow lanes, primary diagnostic artifacts, and suggested follow-up commands before broader re-planning.
commands.successShape: { ok, dryRun, planName, stepCount, executedCount, failedStepIndex?, failureCode?, failureError?, failureWorkflowCategories[], failureRecoveryCategories[], failurePrimaryArtifacts[], recoveryCommands[]:{ command, category }, elapsedMs, steps[]:{ index, action, command, argv, category, requires, expectedArtifacts, stopConditions, failureCode?, error?, ... }, suggestedCommands[] }
